steps.title: Asset Inventory Dashboard
steps.action: IT admin reviews stock and pending hardware tickets
steps.response: Shows available vs assigned laptops and peripherals

steps.title: Master Asset Registry Table
steps.action: Admin reviews historical assignment log and warranty dates
steps.response: Table supports CSV export and hardware audit verification

steps.title: Create Asset Modal
steps.action: Admin registers new device serial number and specifications
steps.response: Adds device to available inventory pool

steps.title: Asset Request Review Queue
steps.action: Admin assigns hardware to employee request
steps.response: Transitions device status from In Stock to Deployed
